about: The owner's notes on Kho Kho Rush, each a test for good (tools/wsg/owner_notes.gd). Never remove one: tools/wsg/owner_notes_guard.sh fails CI if an id once here is gone.

notes.words: When changing to the pole view the joystick movement is wrong.
For some reason while a player is running his arm is stuck sticking straight out.
Some sort of regression. While standing still the chasers arm is just pointing forward.
The tag button is overlapping the kho button
When crossing the foul line the whistles go nuts until you go back, is that supposed to be like that?
Get rid of the replays on tags. On low quality I feel like they will never look good.
Quiet the birds way more they are annoying, it should be barely noticable.
The player is moving himself and dodging by himself when I'm supposed to be playing.
The dive needs better standing up from the dive... they are trying to tag the person. Typically with one arm extended
Sometimes the players are so close it's obvious there would be a tag but they just run right by. We need to fix that.
The runner can run through the kneeling players like they are ghosts.

On a lot of the games when you click start game there is a loading delay ... long enough on the slow phone that users might think the game has frozen. We either need a little load screen or load bar by the start buttons.
Crowd still looks like they are 'in' the seats.
These games live in a world of reality. There will NEVER be a time when a player or referee should walk through a table or bench etc.

The lead's ruling on the owner's Takraw 0.15.27 report, as relayed: "players' stances look like broken backwards knees; refs' knees are bent wrong too" - no knee bends backward on any tier, for players or officials, outside named acrobatics.
